about.free: Every feature of Backseat is free. If you would like to support its development, you can buy me a coffee.
agents.instruction.mcp: I just sent a capture with Backseat. Read the brief and image with the backseat_get tool, id "{id}", and make the changes the annotations and note point to. (file: {brief})
agents.instruction.paths: Read the Backseat brief {brief} and the image {image}, and make the changes the annotations and note point to.
app.tagline: Mark up your screen, explain it out loud, and pass it on to your AI.
brief.activeWindow: Window the user was working in: "{title}" ({process})
brief.annotations.heading: Backseat annotations (added by the user) — in drawing order
brief.compare: Compared with the previous capture: session {id} (annotated.png) · {mode} mode · {percent}% of pixels differ
brief.crop: Crop: only ({x},{y}) {w}×{h} px of the original capture was kept · all coordinates below refer to the cropped image
brief.globals.heading: Global instructions (speech not tied to a specific annotation)
brief.interp.coords: Coordinates are annotated.png pixels. Numbers follow drawing order; text and numbers are instructions about the element at that position; an arrow means "this → there".
brief.interp.heading: Interpretation
brief.interp.speech: 🗣 is what the user said while drawing that annotation. "this/here" means that annotation's position. Transcription is automatic, so numbers and proper nouns may be wrong.
brief.memo.heading: Note
brief.notice: Note: lines, arrows, rectangles, numbered circles with a purple outline and the purple "B" mark in the top-left corner are annotations the user drew with Backseat (they are not part of the original screen).
brief.request.title: Answer to {agent}'s question
brief.voice: Voice: {seconds} s, {model} · full text in transcript.json
brief.voiceMissing: Voice: there is a recording, but it could not be transcribed, so what was said is not in this brief. The recording is in the package.
colorpicker.eyedropperAria: Eyedropper: pick a color from the screen
colorpicker.eyedropperTitle: Pick a color from the screen
editor.color.title: Color
editor.compare.available: Previous capture available: press O to compare before/after
editor.compare.label: Compare with previous capture
editor.compare.loadFailed: Could not load the previous capture
editor.compare.none: No previous capture to compare with. Capture with "{item}" in the tray menu to compare.
editor.compare.overlayTip: Shows the previous capture semi-transparent on top.
editor.compare.status: Comparing with the previous capture: {mode} · O to turn off
editor.compare.wipeTip: Previous capture left of the line, current capture right of it.
editor.status.cropped: Cropped to {w}×{h} px · Ctrl+Z to undo
editor.status.croppedDropped.one: Cropped to {w}×{h} px · removed {n} annotation outside · Ctrl+Z to undo
editor.status.croppedDropped.other: Cropped to {w}×{h} px · removed {n} annotations outside · Ctrl+Z to undo
editor.status.pickColor: Click the capture to pick a color · Esc to cancel
editor.status.pickTarget: Choose where to send it first.
editor.status.pinned: Pinned: the window stays on top, even after sending · Ctrl+P to unpin
editor.sttChoice.message: Your spoken explanation could not be turned into text. Try again, or send the image without it?
editor.target.clipboardNote: Copied to the clipboard · press Ctrl+V where you want it, or choose where to send it
editor.target.expiredNote: The window you picked has closed · choose where to send it again
editor.target.label: → {label}
editor.target.none: Choose where to send it · Sending without a choice copies it to the clipboard
editor.target.pinDefault: Pin this window as the default target
editor.target.rowAutoNone: Automatic: no destination · copy to the clipboard
editor.text.autoTip: Picks a dark or white box to match the text color.
editor.text.effectTip: Keeps the text readable on any background.
editor.text.invertTip: Swaps the text and box colors.
editor.text.outlineTip: Puts an outline around the text.
editor.text.plateTip: Puts a box behind the text.
editor.timeline.hint: Drag to move the playhead · ←→ 0.2 s · Home: start
editor.toolbar.colorTip: Color of pen, shapes, numbers and text
editor.video.noAnnotations: Nothing drawn yet to make a video of
mcp.annotationNotice: The annotations in this image (lines, arrows, rectangles, numbered circles and the purple B mark) were drawn by the user with Backseat and are not part of the original screen.
mcp.askTimeout: The user did not answer within {seconds} seconds (request {requestId}).
mcp.noSession: There are no sessions yet ({root}). One appears when the user captures with Ctrl+Shift+A and sends it.
mcp.waitTimeout: No new capture arrived in time.
requests.title: Request from {agent}
scroll.badge.progress.one: Scrolling capture… {n} frame · {height}px · Esc to stop
scroll.badge.progress.other: Scrolling capture… {n} frames · {height}px · Esc to stop
selector.hint.full: Press Enter to capture the full screen · Esc to cancel
selector.hint.rect: Drag to select a region · Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
selector.hint.scroll: Click the window to scroll: it scrolls to the end and stitches the page · Esc stops
selector.hint.window: Hover over a window and click · Esc to cancel
send.clipboard.chosen: Copied to the clipboard. Paste it anywhere with Ctrl+V.
send.clipboard.noTarget: No destination was chosen, so it was copied to the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V where you want it, or choose where to send it.
send.clipboard.target: {target}: copied to the clipboard. Paste it with Ctrl+V.
send.pasted: Tried to paste into {target} and pressed Enter
send.pastedPressEnter: Tried to paste into {target} · submit it yourself
send.stopped.error: Could not paste · it is ready on the clipboard
send.stopped.focusLost: The focus moved just before pasting, so it stopped · it is ready on the clipboard
send.stopped.notEditable: Could not find the input box in {target}, so nothing was pasted · click the input box and press Ctrl+V
send.stopped.passwordField: That is a password field, so nothing was pasted · click the AI input box and press Ctrl+V
send.stopped.targetChanged: {target} now shows something else, so nothing was pasted · press Send again if it is the right window
send.stopped.targetExpired: {target} has closed, so nothing was pasted · choose where to send it again
send.stopped.uiaUnavailable: Could not check the input box, so nothing was pasted · click the input box and press Ctrl+V
send.targetExpired: {target} has closed, so nothing was sent. Choose where to send it again.
stt.noCloudKey: No key for cloud speech recognition. Set this environment variable
stt.workerExited: Speech recognition stopped unexpectedly · exit code {code}
timeline.hint.linkDrag: Drop on an annotation to link · drop on empty space for automatic · Esc cancels
tray.autoRecord: Record voice when the editor opens
tray.settingsSaveFailed: {error} · The previous settings stay in effect.
tray.target.auto: Automatic: the AI window you used last
tray.target.none: Now: not set · choose when you send
